critical_code_review_comments: BookingDialog builds auth from `user.token` but Board passes `session.user` (no token). Auth still works because axios has withCredentials=true and backend accepts the httpOnly cookie. Consider passing session/token explicitly to remove hidden coupling.

auto_complete_loop uses server-side datetime.now(UTC) but stored HH:MM is clinic-local — could flip today's afternoon bookings early or late depending on server tz. Acceptable for MVP as noted in comment, but worth surfacing a CLINIC_TZ env if the clinic is not in UTC.

Waitlist status color mapping in Waitlist.jsx reuses the appointment status-pill classes ('booked' for waiting, 'completed' for scheduled). Works but is semantically confusing; consider dedicated .waiting/.scheduled classes.

Iteration-6 note still open: the app has multiple independent connectWS instances per view (Board + ActivityView + Waitlist). Each mount opens its own socket. Fine for a small clinic but consider a shared context to cap connections.
server.py has grown to ~617 lines - approaching 700-line split threshold. Waitlist/weekly/auto-complete can move into modules.
